status: separately selected post-hoc curated source/record illustration
selection: One existing qualitative illustration selected for an explicit named revision pair present in the released graph. It is separate from the 33 question units and their classification counts.
request_paraphrase_en: A RAN5 coordination message proposes marking a set of RAN5 CRs agreed after a RAN4 dependency is reported cleared, cites R4-2605846 revised to R4-2607530, and states that further revisions are unnecessary.

source_provenance.locator: JSON-decoded Unicode character offsets, start inclusive, end exclusive
source_provenance.public_text_policy: Technical paraphrase only; source contacts, organization identifiers and embedded nonpublic URLs are omitted.

supported_subquery: Does the released RAN4 graph record R4-2605846 revised to R4-2607530, with whole-target source-verified outcomes and their meetings?
sql: SELECT e.number, l.number, de.code, ge.label, dl.code, gl.label, de.evidence_sha256, dl.evidence_sha256 FROM revision v JOIN document e ON e.id = v.earlier JOIN document l ON l.id = v.later JOIN disposition de ON de.target = e.id JOIN resolution re ON re.id = de.resolution_id JOIN meeting ge ON ge.id = re.meeting_id JOIN disposition dl ON dl.target = l.id JOIN resolution rl ON rl.id = dl.resolution_id JOIN meeting gl ON gl.id = rl.meeting_id WHERE e.number = :earlier AND l.number = :later AND de.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND de.scope = 'whole_target' AND dl.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND dl.scope = 'whole_target' ORDER BY e.number, l.number, de.code, ge.label, dl.code, gl.label
remaining_decision: Whether the RAN4 change clears each RAN5 dependency, whether a RAN5 revision is necessary and whether a RAN5 CR should be agreed require cross-WG technical assessment. The returned RAN4 record corroborates the cited revision/outcome component.
measurement_scope: Read-only record lookup and source-span verification; curated inspection rather than a generated answer or a measured natural-question success.

direct_report_inspection.locator_convention: word/document.xml accepted body blocks, zero-based; header through decision inclusive
